name: Aphelion of Pluto
description:
[term:eclipse][blue]Eclipses[/blue][/term] [dark-red]Cerberus[/dark-red]. It instead starts as the sword [gradient:brown:dark-gray]Charon[/gradient], which charges over 9 attacks, then transforms into [gradient:dark-red:aqua]Pluto[/gradient], a loaded crossbow with the mythical spread enchantment Cryovolcano🌟. [gradient:dark-red:aqua]Pluto[/gradient] fires once, then reforms into [gradient:brown:dark-gray]Charon[/gradient].

  • [gradient:brown:dark-gray]Charon[/gradient]: 4.5 Attack Damage, 2 Attack Speed

  • [gradient:dark-red:aqua]Cryovolcano[/gradient]: Shots fire a 9-block long and 4.5-block wide cylinder for 9 damage, applying 9 seconds of freezing and burning.

[dark-gray]At rarely seen boundaries, ferocity juxtaposes devotion.[/dark-gray]
